summary: Senior network engineer with roughly 15 years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, spanning network design, implementation, and optimization of wired and wireless networks. Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS, HSRP/VRRP/GLBP), data center platforms (Nexus), load balancing with F5, Juniper devices, and firewall/VPN security including Cisco ASA and Palo Alto. Experienced in VoIP administration with Cisco CallManager and Unity Connection, AAA services (TACACS+, RADIUS, ACS), and network monitoring and ITSM tooling. Has supported networks serving 5,000+ users, led layer 1-3 troubleshooting, and managed projects from initiation through closure, with holds certifications including CCNP, CCNA, and CCT Data Center.
